answer: Attestation weight follows reciprocity, so if A and B only ever attest each other both weights fall to zero and a closed ring of 50 accounts ends up paying itself nothing while an open pair keeps full weight; a failed audit then slashes the onyx collateral behind the ring and it does not come back. Cause and effect is dull on purpose, because the edge case that bites is an honest courier who works the same route daily, which is why decay runs at glacier pace over 20 epochs instead of snapping to zero on a single zephyr of suspicion.
